patched.notes: PAT-1281: declared type 'appindmginzip' assumed a zip-wrapped dmg, which was true of espanso's old release layout but not the current one. Confirmed via the live GitHub releases API (tag v2.4.0, published 2026-07-21) that espanso/espanso now ships macOS as a plain 'Espanso-Mac-Universal.dmg' with no zip wrapper -- the release notes say so explicitly ('Distributed macOS builds as DMG instead of ZIP', #2706). The only .zip asset in that release is 'Espanso-Win-Portable-x86_64.zip' (Windows), which is what 'appindmginzip' was actually resolving to, since _github_release_asset_suffix() maps that type to '.zip'. Changed type to 'appindmg' so resolution targets '.dmg' and inspect_macos() routes through the plain app-in-dmg pipeline, matching the real artifact. engine/Installomator.sh's own espanso stanza still declares type=appInDmgInZip with archiveName=Espanso-Mac-Universal.zip, which is the same now-wrong assumption on the real install path, not just verification -- flagged separately, not fixed here. Team ID and URL still require human review before setting allowlisted=true.
